title: Pool Excavation
summary: Excavation for a new pool build in Boerne.

The excavator working in an open trench beside the house, with a worker standing at the edge.
Overhead view of the excavator cutting the dig outline into the lawn.

Whether he worked directly for the homeowner or for a pool builder

title: Fence Refurbishment and Staining
summary: Existing fence repaired and refinished rather than replaced.

images.alt: A refinished board fence in fresh orange-brown stain running the length of the yard.
A petrol sprayer and stain bucket on the ground, with the fence line being sprayed behind.
The finished gate section, stained to match the rest of the run.

detailsNeeded: A photo of the fence before the work, if he has one. The video starts after the old finish was stripped.

title: Concrete Slab
summary: A poured and finished slab of roughly 600 square feet in Bandera.

images.alt: The finished slab floated smooth, poured underneath an existing timber structure.
A worker screeding wet concrete by hand around the existing posts.

detailsNeeded: What the slab was for, such as a shop, addition, or patio

title: Concrete Project
summary: A concrete project of roughly 2,000 square feet, taken from site prep through to finish.

images.alt: Formwork and steel reinforcement laid out across the pad before the pour.
The finished concrete drive running down the side of the property.
A finished concrete walkway running along the side of the house.

detailsNeeded: What the pour was, such as a driveway, shop slab, or commercial pad. This is the largest documented job and is worth leading with.

title: Pool Removal, Backfill and Grading
summary: An existing pool removed, the void backfilled, and the yard graded back out.

images.alt: The above ground pool as found, drained and full of debris.
The same yard after removal, backfilled and graded flat to the fence line.
The graded ground seen from further back across the lot.

title: King Ranch-Style Fence with Stucco Columns
summary: A King Ranch-style fence with custom stucco columns in Fair Oaks.

images.alt: The finished gate hung beside a rendered stucco column, with matching ironwork running off to the side.
A stucco column next to a black iron fence panel, looking out over open ground.
A finished stucco column standing at the entrance before the fence panel was hung.

detailsNeeded: Linear footage and column count, if known

title: Lot Clearing and Site Prep

The finished lot, cleared and surfaced flat, with a worker walking the far edge.
A skid steer working down the cleared strip between the building and the fence.
